text: Michelin's parent company Compagnie Générale des Établissements Michelin (CGEM) is organized as a partnership limited by shares (SCA). As of 31 December 2025, BlackRock Inc. held 6.12% of its share capital and Capital Group Companies 5.07%, and to the best of the Company's knowledge no other shareholder directly or indirectly holds more than 5% of the share capital and voting rights.

source.name: Michelin 2025 Universal Registration Document, section 2.11 Ownership structure and voting rights
source.quote: BlackRock Inc. held 6.12% of the share capital and less than 5% of the voting rights
